name: Apache Fineract
description: Fineract provides a reliable, robust, and affordable solution for entrepreneurs, financial institutions, and service providers to offer financial services to the world’s 3 billion underbanked and unbanked.

name: Bisa Health
description: Bisa is a health application that allows the public to receive health information and communicate with doctors.

name: Boxtribute
description: An open-source digital system making it easy to rapidly and collaboratively source, store & distribute humanitarian aid to people in need in a fair and dignified way.

name: cfr
description: R package to estimate disease severity and under-reporting in real-time, accounting for reporting delays in epidemic time-series

name: CodiTeach
description: CodiTeach is an innovative web platform for teachers that streamlines account management for schools, classes, and students. Platform provides a royalty-free alternative to costly educational platforms for underfunded schools in impoverished developing countries.

name: Community Health Toolkit
description: The CHT is a license-free, open-source digital health platform that includes a collection of software frameworks and applications, open-access resources, and a dynamic community of practice to help partners design, own, and scale electronic community health information systems.

name: CREDEBL
description: The CREDEBL platform helps Governments and private entities implement a digital, foundational identity issuance and verification solution in a cost effective way by leveraging W3C Standards.

name: Designsystemet
description: Designsystemet is a publicly maintained open-source design system, owned and coordinated by the Norwegian Digitalisation Agency. It helps create accessible, user-friendly digital services across the public and private sectors.

name: DHIS2
description: DHIS2 is a free, open-source, fully customizable platform for collecting, analyzing, visualizing, and sharing aggregate and individual-data for district-level, national, regional, and international system and program management in health, education, and other domains.

name: DIGIT
description: DIGIT is an open-source, configurable, extendable, modular, digital infrastructure that enables local governments to deliver municipal services to citizens in an efficient, inclusive, and transparent manner.

name: Digital Impact Exchange
description: This is an interactive, multitenant online platform designed to simplify the discovery and evaluation of digital options. It serves as a comprehensive resource for people working to tracking their digital footprint by providing a catalog, a marketplace, and a resource library.

name: Drupal
description: Drupal is an open source content management system powering ambitious digital experiences across government, higher-ed, non-profit, and other sectors for more than 20 years.

name: Ersilia Model Hub
description: The Ersilia Model Hub is the only open-source platform serving ready-to-use AI models to accelerate the discovery of new treatments for infectious diseases which affect predominantly the Global South.

name: Feluda
description: Feluda is a configurable engine for analysing multi-lingual and multi-modal content. While flexible, it is built it to analyse data collected from social media - images,text and video. It is configurable to allow for different use cases such as finding trends and narratives in social media across languages, and surfacing fact checked content corresponding to image and video.

name: finalsize
description: finalsize is an R package that provides estimates for the total proportion of a population infected over the course of an epidemic, and can account for a demographic distribution, demography-specific contact patterns,and heterogeneous susceptibility to infection between groups.

name: Glific
description: ENABLING IMPACT AT SCALE - Our WhatsApp chatbot enables you to reach the right person at the right time with the right information.

name: Harmony
description: Harmony is an open-source, end-to end data integration and advanced analytics platform for integrating, harmonizing, analyzing, and visualizing any number of structured data sources from different sectors (e.g. health, education, agriculture, sustainable development, climate change adaptation), ranging from routinely collected individual level data to operational research and survey data.

name: Interfacer
description: Innovative federated open source platform that provides a digital product passport. With a focus to find and share open source hardware projects, collaborate with others, and discover new products and services. Import your projects to allow access to the community and grow your reputation.

name: IVTToken
description: This initiative connects under connected schools to the internet through a blockchain model, rewarding ISPs and sponsors with connectivity tokens. Supported by UNICEF, it focuses on usability and scalability to enhance global educational access.

name: LocalGov Drupal
description: LocalGov Drupal is an open source content management system, built on Drupal, optimised for use by public sector organisations for their public facing corporate websites.

name: magasin
description: Magasin is a cloud native open-source end-to-end data platform. Magasin enables organizations to perform automatic data ingestion, storage, analysis, ML/AI compute and visualization at scale.

name: Mastodon
description: Mastodon is a free and open-source software platform for decentralized social networking.

name: Mojaloop
description: Open source software for creating payment platforms that will help unbanked people access digital financial services.

name: MOSIP
description: The Modular Open Source Identity Platform (MOSIP) helps Governments and other user organizations implement a digital, foundational identity system in a cost effective way.

name: Open Terms Archive
description: Open Terms Archive publicly records every version of the terms of digital services to enable democratic oversight.

name: OpenCRVS
description: OpenCRVS is a user-friendly, open-source platform designed to make civil registration accessible and effective for everyone. It supports the complete process of registering vital events, such as births and deaths, while ensuring offline functionality for remote areas, robust data security, and adherence to global CRVS standards. Tailored for low- and middle-income countries, OpenCRVS is user-centric, inclusive, and enables governments to provide legal identity for all, improve access to essential services, and generate vital statistics for policy-making.

name: OpenFisca
description: OpenFisca is a Rules as Code engine: it enables collaboratively making laws and regulations computable over APIs for developers, datascientists and researchers. This allows building software to help citizens and businesses understand how laws apply to them, designing better rules and public policies, debating potential reforms, and scaling economic micro-simulation.

name: OpenG2P
description: OpenG2P is an open-source platform that enables governments and humanitarian organizations to deliver critical social benefits directly to those who need them. It facilitates the building of secure, inclusive registries and digital cash transfer systems for social protection.

name: openIMIS
description: openIMIS is a versatile open source software which supports the administration of health financing and social protection schemes. It is specially designed to manage the complex, high-volume data flows which are required to operate such schemes by seamlessly integrating beneficiary, provider and payer data in a single platform.

name: Rafiki
description: Rafiki is open source software that financial service providers run to add Interledger functionality to the accounts they service. It implements the Open Payments API and the Interledger Protocol, connecting providers across different payment networks.

name: SPICE
description: SPICE is a community-based platform for data-driven population health. SPICE leverages clinical algorithms to screen, refer, and manage patients based on clinical risk, transforming care delivery from reactive to proactive while linking community-based work bi-directionally with health facilities and health systems

name: Syft
description: Syft allows external researchers to securely conduct remote data science while protecting privacy, security, and intellectual property.

name: Trade Trust
description: TradeTrust is an open-source software that digitizes international trade documents, reducing paperwork, documentation costs, and the risks of fraud. TradeTrust enables industry to verify a document's authenticity and create Electronic Transferable Records (ETRs).

name: TruBudget
description: A blockchain-based workflow tool for an efficient and transparent project management

name: UPYOG
description: The Urban Platform for DeliverY of Online Governance (UPYOG) is a set of Open APIs, services, and reference implementations, setup as a public good, to allow government entities, businesses, startups, and civil society to use a unique digital Infrastructure and build solutions at a large scale. Developed under the National Urban Digital Mission, MoHUA to facilitate the digital delivery of G2G, G2C, G2B services focussing on citizen centricity, UPYOG is available with customizable 14 reference modules.

name: WSO2 Identity Server
description: WSO2 Identity Server is an open-source Identity and Access Management (IAM) solution supporting secure authentication, identity federation, and user management via open standards such as OAuth2, OpenID Connect, SAML, SCIM 2.0, and FIDO2.
